system.description:
You release a mist formed of illusory chakra as you suppress the targets mental combat potential.

One creature of your choice within range must make a Wisdom saving throw.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Failure: Affected creature becomes Envenomed and Weakened for the duration.

Critical Failure: Same a failure, and the affected creature also reduces their speed by 10 Feet.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and increase the ranks of either Envenomed or Weakened by +1.
